subject: Audit rights & evidence cadence: proposed pen-test window and access plan
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@lumina-dx.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Kurt Vogel <kurt.vogel@medallionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit questions — SOC 2 & pen-test window

Hi Priya / Laura,

Thanks for the earlier notes. As part of our procurement checklist for Medallion Health we're trying to lock down the security exhibit language and the pen-test cadence so our InfoSec team can sign off. A few specific asks: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a single external (black-box) pen-test or require privileged inspection / sampling? Our compliance team prefers limited-scope privileged inspection but we need to understand Redwood's constraints.
- Proposed window preference: Sept 27-29 or Oct 4-6 — which works on your side for staging access and dedicated heat windows?
- We'll need the most recent SOC 2 (Type II) report and a short list of evidence owners for the items called out (audit logs, MFA, key management).
- Also attaching a short questionnaire from our auditors with a few targeted fields (Lumina-question-set.xlsx).

Can we get a consolidated response today so we can lock the procurement timeline? Our deadline to present to the internal committee is Friday.

Best,
Samantha
Director, Security & Compliance
Lumina Diagnostics

Attachment: Lumina-question-set.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@lumina-dx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit questions — SOC 2 & pen-test window

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list and for the questionnaire. Quick answers up-front, then a couple clarifying Qs so we give the right level of detail: 

Quick answers:
- SOC 2 Type II: yes, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and our SOC2 point-of-contact for evidence follow-up.
- Pen-test: we support both models. Our standard approach for new customers is a black-box external pen-test, but we can entertain a privileged/limited inspection if you identify the specific systems and we spin a scoped staging environment.
- Windows: we currently have capacity for a limited dedicated window the week of Sept 27 — prefer 27th or 28th for minimal customer impact.

Clarifying questions:
1) If you prefer privileged inspection, which services/endpoints must be included (API endpoints, management plane, customer-staging data)?
2) Do you require full source-level access or elevated accounts for specific test cases? (our on-prem/private customers sometimes request elevated access; hosted customers typically get scoped service accounts)
3) Are there required vendors for the test (you mentioned a 3rd-party vendor)? If so, please share contact and scope doc.

I'll pull together a short redline to the security exhibit and a proposed evidence cadence for the items in your questionnaire and loop in Karthik and Laura for legal/ops review by EOD. If you confirm preferred window today I'll reserve the slot with our infra team.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Audit questions — redline draft + pen-test ops (internal)

Team — forwarding Samantha's questionnaire. Draft redlines attached: redline_security_exhibit_v1.docx and an ops note pen_test_ops_sla.md. Key points I'm proposing we give Lumina: 

- Security exhibit language: add a one-paragraph permitted inspection clause that allows either black-box testing or "limited privileged inspection" subject to pre-approved scope and a staging-only environment. Sample wording is in the redline (see clause 4.2.3).
- Evidence cadence: offer a 30-day evidence handoff window for SOC2 items (audit logs, MFA attestation, KMS access logs) with named owners; propose an SLA of 5 business days for property-level evidence requests and 10 business days for systems-level artifacts.
- Pen-test ops: we will accept 3rd-party pentesters on our approved vendor list; if Lumina insists on their vendor, require a short attestation + mutual NDA and a scoped staging account (no production creds). Ops note lists technical constraints and required IP allowlisting.

Ask: can you both review the attached redline and ops note and confirm wording (particularly the privileged-inspection paragraph) by 5pm PST? Legal / Karthik — we might need to tweak indemnity and discovery language. Laura — are the proposed evidence SLAs reasonable from the audit ops perspective?

Thanks,
Priya

Attachments referenced: redline_security_exhibit_v1.docx, pen_test_ops_sla.md
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@lumina-dx.com>, Kurt Vogel <kurt.vogel@medallionhealth.com>, PenTestOps <ops@thirdparty-pen.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit questions — SOC 2 & pen-test window

Hi Samantha / Kurt / PenTestOps team — thanks for the patience while we pulled internal alignment. Below is our consolidated proposal; I've attached a PDF copy of the proposed audit addendum for ease of review (proposed_audit_addendum_v1.pdf).

Proposal summary:
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and the contact for evidence follow-up (Laura Bennett). We can commit to named evidence owners and the following handoff SLA: 5 business days for property-level artifacts (config screenshots, role lists), 10 business days for systems-level artifacts (logs, KMS access records).
- Pen-test options: a) Black-box external test (no privileged access) on a dedicated staging environment; or b) Limited privileged inspection on a scoped staging instance. For option (b) we require an approved scope doc in advance and a signed staging access addendum (attached).
- Vendor: We are able to accept third-party vendors. If you wish to use PenTestOps, we'll need their insurance attestation + NDA and a short ops questionnaire (I've cc'ed PenTestOps to start that flow).
- Dates: We can reserve Sept 27 or Sept 28 for a 48-hour window. Please confirm preference by EOD tomorrow; otherwise we'll default to Sept 27.
- Next steps: 1) Confirm preferred pen-test model (black-box vs limited privileged), 2) If privileged, provide endpoint list and vendor attestation, 3) Sign the staging access addendum (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/signing/ABCDEF-123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/890123

Attachments: proposed_audit_addendum_v1.pdf (pdf) — contains the redline language and the staging access checklist.

Would welcome a short 30-minute call if that helps — happy to join with Karthik and Laura.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193
